_comment: #279: the comment thread `redline demo` seeds. Read the four cards, then write your own — they teach what the overlay can hold. Deliberately NOT work to be done: a watcher leaves pre-existing comments alone (that is the rule, so it never rewrites your backlog), so these stay put and stay readable.

comments.body:
"clear every bar" is doing a lot of work here. Say which bars, or cut the claim.

This is an EDIT REQUEST — the ordinary kind. An attached agent session rewrites the sentence, replies saying what changed, and marks this addressed.

anchor.quote: the numbers now clear every bar we set in January
anchor.prefix: We should open the Fremont location in March —
anchor.suffix: , and the lease window closes in six weeks

comments.body:
Check the 34% against the corridor BID's own count before this goes out.

This is a NOTE — see the chip on the card. Notes are context, never work: nothing edits this text on the strength of it, and Send All skips it. Use notes for anything you want remembered but not acted on.

anchor.quote: Weekend foot traffic on the corridor is up 34% year over year
anchor.suffix: , and our wholesale accounts in the neighborhood have doubled

comments.body:
Is the espresso machine lead time a supplier quote or an estimate?

A QUESTION gets an answer and stays OPEN. You decide when your question is answered — an agent replying to it does not close it, because being told something is not the same as being satisfied.

anchor.quote: a second espresso machine delay would push opening past the summer lull

replies.body: Supplier quote — Ferrara, 9–11 weeks, confirmed 18 July. I have left this open; close it yourself when you are happy.
replies.creator: agent

comments.body:
Drop the participant list, it is internal.

This one was DECLINED and the card says why. An agent that disagrees pushes back rather than complying — declining is a real outcome, not a failure, and the reasoning stays on the thread where you can argue with it.

resolution.summary: Left the participant list in place
